sources.title: AI escape velocity: A conversation with Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: Claims are shown as paraphrases unless identified as a verified quotation.

reference.criterion: Renewable generation supplies all global electricity demand within ten years of the 2024 interview.
reference.rationale: The interview implies a 2034 deadline, still pending. IEA places renewables at 34% of 2025 world electricity generation. This is substantial progress but not 100%.
